notes: The repository is the canonical source of query texts, metadata and source references.
Source references identify pinned PDF pages for editorial verification; they are not exclusive relevance targets or qrels. Corpus excerpts are not bundled.
Search receives text only. Pair judges receive id/text/neutral intent plus the candidate passage and provenance; source_refs and editorial metadata are excluded.
Evaluate all English core queries, with no difficulty quota or dev/holdout split. Budget limits bound judge work per invocation, not the query set.
All questions have received editorial source checking. Independent provider review remains pending; this is not human validation or a sample of observed search traffic.
architecture_scope both measures result-set coverage; useful single-ISA passages are not penalized for lacking the other architecture.
Revision 7 adds q199 (FS Initial) and q200 (supervisor access to stimecmp) within the pinned RISC-V Privileged source. Existing queries and translation anchors are unchanged.
Default runs include all English queries and all Russian/Chinese probes, with separate language reports. Schema 7 removes metadata that no code reads; query texts and intents are unchanged.
